issue: Does a conspiracy to commit a drug offense under 21 U.S.C. § 846, which has no overt-act element, qualify as a 'controlled substance offense' under U.S.S.G. § 4B1.2(b) and Application Note 1?

sides.position: A § 846 conspiracy qualifies as a controlled substance offense under § 4B1.2(b) and Application Note 1, even without an overt-act element.
cases: United States v. Tabb, 949 F.3d 81 (2d Cir. 2020)
United States v. Rivera-Constantino, 798 F.3d 900 (9th Cir. 2015)
United States v. Sanbria-Bueno, 549 F. App'x 434 (6th Cir.)
United States v. Rodriguez-Rivera, 989 F.3d 183 (1st Cir. 2021)
